name: enderbit_earn_ouo_resident
label: Enderbit Earn Ouo 半接口常驻流程
script: async function(agent) {
const wait = (ms) => agent.wait(ms);
const log = async (message) => { if (agent.log) await agent.log('[Enderbit Ouo 半接口] ' + message); };
const notifyId = (agent.variables && agent.variables.tg_notify_chat_id) || '5878981847';
const hourlyNotifyKey = 'enderbit_earn_ouo_last_hourly_notify';

const buildHourKey = (date) => date.getFullYear() + '-' + String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0') + '-' + String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0') + '-' + String(date.getHours()).padStart(2, '0');
const countKey = 'enderbit_earn_ouo_claim_count';
const logsKey = 'enderbit_earn_ouo_panel_logs';
const balanceKey = 'enderbit_earn_ouo_last_balance';
const cooldownUntilKey = 'enderbit_earn_ouo_cooldown_until';
const variables = agent.variables || {};
const host = location.hostname.toLowerCase();
const isEnderbit = host === 'dash.enderbit.com';
const isOuo = host === 'ouo.io' || host.endsWith('.ouo.io') || host === 'ouo.press' || host.endsWith('.ouo.press');
const textOf = (el) => ((el && (el.innerText || el.textContent)) || '').trim();
const checkpoint = async (nextVariables) => { await agent.checkpoint(nextVariables || {}); Object.assign(variables, nextVariables || {}); };
const getJson = (key, fallback) => { try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key) || ''); } catch (error) { return fallback; } };
const setJson = (key, value) => { try { localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(value)); } catch (error) {} };

const readBalance = () => { const label = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('p')).find((el) => textOf(el).toLowerCase().includes('your balance')); const card = label ? label.closest('.text-center') : null; const value = card ? textOf(card.querySelector('.text-3xl.font-bold.text-white')) : ''; if (value) return value; const fallback = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.text-3xl.font-bold.text-white')).map(textOf).find((text) => Number.isFinite(Number(text))); return fallback || ''; };

const parseCooldownMs = (text) => { const raw = String(text || '').trim(); if (!raw) return 0; if (raw.includes(':')) { const parts = raw.split(':').map((part) => Number(part)); if (parts.length === 2 && parts.every(Number.isFinite)) return (parts[0] * 60 + parts[1]) * 1000; if (parts.length === 3 && parts.every(Number.isFinite)) return ((parts[0] * 60 + parts[1]) * 60 + parts[2]) * 1000; } const lower = raw.toLowerCase(); const found = lower.match(/[0-9]+(?:[.][0-9]+)?/); const number = found ? Number(found[0]) : 0; if (!number) return 0; if (lower.includes('hour') || lower.includes('小时')) return number * 3600000; if (lower.includes('min') || lower.includes('minute') || lower.includes('分钟')) return number * 60000; if (lower.includes('sec') || lower.includes('second') || lower.includes('秒')) return number * 1000; return 0; };

const readCooldownText = () => { const candidates = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('span.font-mono, .font-mono')).map(textOf).filter(Boolean); return candidates.find((text) => parseCooldownMs(text) > 0) || ''; };
const readLocalCooldownMs = () => Math.max(0, Number(localStorage.getItem(cooldownUntilKey) || '0') - Date.now());

const formatMs = (ms) => { const total = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(ms / 1000)); const minutes = Math.floor(total / 60); const seconds = total % 60; return String(minutes).padStart(2, '0') + ':' + String(seconds).padStart(2, '0'); };
const readCooldownMs = () => readLocalCooldownMs() || parseCooldownMs(readCooldownText());
const clearCooldown = () => { localStorage.removeItem(cooldownUntilKey); window.__enderbitReloading = false; };
const getStageTimeoutMs = (stage) => { if (stage === 'ouo_request' || stage === 'enderbit_collect') return 60000; if (stage === 'ouo_human' || stage === 'ouo_get_link') return 120000; return 0; };

const markStage = async (stage, patch) => { const now = Date.now(); const next = { ...(patch || {}), stage, lastProgressAt: now }; if (variables.stage !== stage) { next.stageStartedAt = now; next.stageReloadCount = 0; } await checkpoint(next); };

const checkStageWatchdog = async () => { const timeout = getStageTimeoutMs(variables.stage); if (!timeout || variables.stage === 'cooldown') return false; const startedAt = Number(variables.lastProgressAt || variables.stageStartedAt || 0); if (!startedAt || Date.now() - startedAt < timeout) return false; const reloadCount = Number(variables.stageReloadCount || 0) + 1; if (reloadCount <= 2) { await panelLog('阶段 ' + variables.stage + ' 超时，刷新兜底 ' + reloadCount + '/2'); await checkpoint({ stageReloadCount: reloadCount, lastProgressAt: Date.now() }); await agent.reload(); return true; } await panelLog('阶段 ' + variables.stage + ' 连续超时，重置到 start'); clearCooldown(); await checkpoint({ stage: 'start', collected: false, ouoUrl: '', stageStartedAt: Date.now(), lastProgressAt: Date.now(), stageReloadCount: 0 }); return false; };
const readCount = () => Number(localStorage.getItem(countKey) || '0') || 0;
const writeCount = (count) => localStorage.setItem(countKey, String(count));
const getPanelLogs = () => getJson(logsKey, []);
const writePanelLogs = (logs) => setJson(logsKey, logs.slice(0, 8));

const pushNotify = async (reason) => { const label = reason || '状态汇报'; const balance = readBalance() || localStorage.getItem(balanceKey) || 'unknown'; if (balance && balance !== 'unknown') localStorage.setItem(balanceKey, balance); const cooldownText = readLocalCooldownMs() > 0 ? formatMs(readLocalCooldownMs()) : (readCooldownText() || '-'); await agent.report({ success: true, message: 'EnderBit 状态汇报', variables: { tg_notify_chat_id: notifyId, notify_title: 'EnderBit 状态汇报', notify_balance: balance === 'unknown' ? 'unknown coins' : balance + ' coins', notify_reason: label, notify_count: String(readCount()), notify_cooldown: cooldownText } }); await panelLog('已提交脚本通知：' + label); };

const maybeHourlyNotify = async () => { if (!isEnderbit) return; const now = new Date(); if (now.getMinutes() !== 0) return; const hourKey = buildHourKey(now); if (localStorage.getItem(hourlyNotifyKey) === hourKey) return; localStorage.setItem(hourlyNotifyKey, hourKey); await pushNotify('整点汇报'); };

const ensurePanel = () => { let panel = document.getElementById('__enderbit_resident_panel'); if (panel) return panel; panel = document.createElement('div'); panel.id = '__enderbit_resident_panel'; panel.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;right:14px;bottom:14px;z-index:2147483647;background:rgba(12,12,27,.96);color:#e5e7eb;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);border-radius:12px;padding:12px 14px;font:13px/1.45 monospace;box-shadow:0 12px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.42);min-width:260px;max-width:320px;'; document.documentElement.appendChild(panel); return panel; };

const appendLine = (parent, left, right, color) => { const row = document.createElement('div'); row.style.cssText = 'display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;padding:2px 0;'; const a = document.createElement('span'); a.textContent = left; const b = document.createElement('span'); b.textContent = right; b.style.color = color || '#facc15'; b.style.fontWeight = '700'; row.append(a, b); parent.appendChild(row); };

const renderPanel = (status, extra) => { if (!isEnderbit) return; const panel = ensurePanel(); panel.replaceChildren(); const title = document.createElement('div'); title.textContent = 'EnderBit-Coins'; title.style.cssText = 'color:#4ade80;font-weight:800;font-size:16px;margin-bottom:8px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);padding-bottom:7px;'; panel.appendChild(title); const balance = readBalance() || localStorage.getItem(balanceKey) || '-'; if (balance && balance !== '-') localStorage.setItem(balanceKey, balance); appendLine(panel, '金币', balance); appendLine(panel, '累计领取', String(readCount()), '#4ade80'); appendLine(panel, '倒计时', readLocalCooldownMs() > 0 ? formatMs(readLocalCooldownMs()) : (readCooldownText() || '-'), '#facc15'); appendLine(panel, '状态', status || '-', '#93c5fd'); if (extra) appendLine(panel, '信息', extra, '#e5e7eb'); const box = document.createElement('div'); box.style.cssText = 'margin-top:8px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.28);border-radius:8px;padding:6px;max-height:150px;overflow:auto;'; getPanelLogs().forEach((line) => { const item = document.createElement('div'); item.textContent = line; item.style.cssText = 'border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);padding:2px 0;white-space:pre-wrap;'; box.appendChild(item); }); panel.appendChild(box); const buttonRow = document.createElement('div'); buttonRow.style.cssText = 'display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;margin-top:8px;'; const push = document.createElement('button'); push.type = 'button'; push.textContent = '手动推送'; push.style.cssText = 'border:0;border-radius:8px;padding:7px;background:#16a34a;color:#fff;cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;'; push.addEventListener('click', () => { pushNotify('手动推送').catch((error) => panelLog('手动推送失败：' + (error && error.message ? error.message : String(error)))); }); const clear = document.createElement('button'); clear.type = 'button'; clear.textContent = '清空日志'; clear.style.cssText = 'border:0;border-radius:8px;padding:7px;background:#3f3f46;color:#e5e7eb;cursor:pointer;'; clear.addEventListener('click', () => { writePanelLogs([]); renderPanel(status, extra); }); buttonRow.append(push, clear); panel.appendChild(buttonRow); };

const panelLog = async (message) => { await log(message); if (!isEnderbit) return; const stamp = new Date().toLocaleTimeString(); const logs = getPanelLogs(); logs.unshift(stamp + '  ' + message); writePanelLogs(logs); renderPanel(message); };

const startPanelTimer = (status) => { if (!isEnderbit) return; window.__enderbitPanelStatus = status || window.__enderbitPanelStatus || '待机'; renderPanel(window.__enderbitPanelStatus); if (window.__enderbitPanelTimer) clearInterval(window.__enderbitPanelTimer); window.__enderbitPanelTimer = setInterval(() => { renderPanel(window.__enderbitPanelStatus); maybeHourlyNotify().catch((error) => panelLog('整点推送失败：' + (error && error.message ? error.message : String(error)))); checkStageWatchdog().catch((error) => panelLog('阶段兜底检查失败：' + (error && error.message ? error.message : String(error)))); if (readLocalCooldownMs() <= 0 && variables.stage === 'cooldown' && !window.__enderbitStartingNext) { window.__enderbitStartingNext = true; clearCooldown(); markStage('start', { collected: false }).then(() => panelLog('冷却结束，当前页直接开始下一轮')).then(() => startEnderbitRound()).catch((error) => panelLog('进入下一轮失败：' + (error && error.message ? error.message : String(error)))).finally(() => { window.__enderbitStartingNext = false; }); } }, 1000); };

const apiFetch = async (path, options) => { const opts = options || {}; const apiUrl = path.startsWith('http://') || path.startsWith('https://') ? path : new URL(path, location.origin).href; const response = await fetch(apiUrl, { method: opts.method || 'GET', credentials: 'include', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...(opts.headers || {}) }, body: opts.body }); const raw = await response.text(); let data = {}; try { data = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : {}; } catch (error) { data = { message: raw }; } if (!response.ok) { const err = new Error((data && (data.message || data.error)) || ('HTTP ' + response.status)); err.status = response.status; err.data = data; throw err; } return data || {}; };

const parseWaitMsFromMessage = (message) => { const lower = String(message || '').toLowerCase(); const found = lower.match(/[0-9]+/); const value = found ? Number(found[0]) : 60; if (lower.includes('hour')) return value * 3600000; if (lower.includes('minute') || lower.includes('min')) return value * 60000; return value * 1000; };

const cutFrom = (text, marker) => { const start = String(text || '').indexOf(marker); if (start < 0) return ''; const stops = [String.fromCharCode(34), String.fromCharCode(39), '<', '>', ' ', ')']; let end = String(text).length; stops.forEach((stop) => { const pos = String(text).indexOf(stop, start); if (pos >= 0 && pos < end) end = pos; }); return String(text).slice(start, end); };
const findCallbackInText = (text) => cutFrom(text, 'https://dash.enderbit.com/earn?collect=') || cutFrom(text, 'https://dash.enderbit.com/api/earn/callback/');
const extractCollectToken = (url) => { try { const parsed = new URL(url); return parsed.searchParams.get('collect') || ''; } catch (error) { return ''; } };

const resolveCollectUrl = async (url) => { if (!url) return ''; if (extractCollectToken(url)) return url; if (url.includes('/api/earn/callback/')) { const response = await agent.http({ url, method: 'GET', responseType: 'text', credentials: 'include', redirect: 'follow', timeoutMs: 30000 }); if (response.url && extractCollectToken(response.url)) return response.url; return findCallbackInText(response.data); } return ''; };

const maybeCollectByUrl = async (url) => { const resolved = await resolveCollectUrl(url); const token = extractCollectToken(resolved); if (!token) return false; await log('已从请求结果提取 collect token'); const result = await apiFetch('/api/earn/collect', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ token }) }); if (!result.success) throw new Error(result.message || 'collect failed'); writeCount(readCount() + Number(result.coins || 1)); await panelLog('领取成功'); await markStage('cooldown', { collected: true, collectedAt: Date.now() }); return true; };

const parseOuoPost = (html, originalUrl, finalUrl) => { const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(String(html || ''), 'text/html'); const original = new URL(originalUrl); const finalTarget = finalUrl ? new URL(finalUrl, original.href) : original; const params = new URLSearchParams(); Array.from(doc.querySelectorAll('input[name]')).forEach((input) => params.append(input.name, input.value || '')); return { action: finalTarget.origin + '/xreallycygo' + original.pathname, body: params.toString(), fieldNames: Array.from(params.keys()).join(',') || '[无字段]', formCount: doc.querySelectorAll('form').length, title: textOf(doc.querySelector('title')) || '[无标题]' }; };

const requestOuoCallback = async (ouoUrl) => { const target = new URL(ouoUrl); await log('请求模拟 Ouo：GET ' + target.href); const first = await agent.http({ url: target.href, method: 'GET', responseType: 'text', credentials: 'include', redirect: 'follow', timeoutMs: 30000 }); if (!first.ok) throw new Error('Ouo GET HTTP ' + first.status + ' ' + (first.error || '')); const direct = first.url && await resolveCollectUrl(first.url); if (direct) return direct; const embedded = findCallbackInText(first.data); if (embedded) return embedded; const form = parseOuoPost(first.data, target.href, first.url || target.href); await log('请求模拟 Ouo：POST ' + form.action + '；标题：' + form.title + '；表单数：' + form.formCount + '；字段：' + form.fieldNames); const postOrigin = new URL(form.action).origin; const second = await agent.http({ url: form.action, method: 'POST', responseType: 'text', credentials: 'include', redirect: 'follow', timeoutMs: 45000, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded', 'Origin': postOrigin, 'Referer': first.url || target.href }, body: form.body }); const locationHeader = second.headers && (second.headers.location || second.headers.Location) ? (second.headers.location || second.headers.Location) : ''; const absoluteLocation = locationHeader ? new URL(locationHeader, form.action).href : ''; if (absoluteLocation && await resolveCollectUrl(absoluteLocation)) return absoluteLocation; if (second.url && await resolveCollectUrl(second.url)) return second.url; const fromBody = findCallbackInText(second.data); if (fromBody) return fromBody; throw new Error('Ouo 请求没有返回 collect；GET最终地址：' + (first.url || '-') + '；GET标题：' + form.title + '；表单数：' + form.formCount + '；POST目标：' + form.action + '；字段：' + form.fieldNames + '；POST状态：' + second.status + '；Location：' + (absoluteLocation || '-') + '；最终地址：' + (second.url || '-') + '；GET摘要：' + String(first.data || '').slice(0, 120) + '；响应摘要：' + String(second.data || '').slice(0, 120)); };

const buildFinishResult = async (collected, fallbackMs, note) => { const cooldownText = readCooldownText(); const cooldownMs = readCooldownMs(); const waitMs = cooldownMs > 0 ? cooldownMs + 3000 : Math.max(Number(fallbackMs) || 60000, 1000) + 3000; const nextRunAt = Date.now() + waitMs; localStorage.setItem(cooldownUntilKey, String(nextRunAt)); const balance = readBalance() || localStorage.getItem(balanceKey) || ''; const reason = note || (collected ? '领取成功，等待下一轮' : '冷却中'); if (balance) localStorage.setItem(balanceKey, balance); await checkpoint({ stage: 'cooldown', collected, cooldownUntil: nextRunAt }); startPanelTimer(collected ? '领取成功' : '冷却中'); await panelLog(note || ('冷却 ' + (cooldownText || Math.round(waitMs / 1000) + 's'))); return { status: 'waiting', message: reason, variables: { stage: 'cooldown', collected, cooldownUntil: nextRunAt } }; };

const startEnderbitRound = async () => { const cooldownMs = readCooldownMs(); if (cooldownMs > 0) return buildFinishResult(false); window.__enderbitPanelStatus = '请求接口'; await panelLog('请求接口'); await markStage('ouo_request', { collected: false }); let generated = null; try { generated = await apiFetch('/api/earn/generate', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({}) }); } catch (error) { const message = error && error.message ? error.message : String(error); if (message.toLowerCase().includes('please wait') || message.toLowerCase().includes('before earning again')) { await panelLog('接口冷却：' + message); return buildFinishResult(false, parseWaitMsFromMessage(message), message); } throw error; } if (!generated.url) throw new Error('generate did not return url'); await panelLog('生成 Ouo 链接，开始请求模拟'); await markStage('ouo_request', { generatedCoins: generated.coins || 1, collected: false, ouoUrl: generated.url }); try { const callbackUrl = await requestOuoCallback(generated.url); if (await maybeCollectByUrl(callbackUrl)) { await agent.navigate('https://dash.enderbit.com/earn'); return { status: 'waiting', variables: { stage: 'cooldown', collected: true } }; } } catch (error) { const message = error && error.message ? error.message : String(error); await panelLog('请求模拟失败，打开 Ouo 兜底：' + message); } await markStage('ouo_human', { generatedCoins: generated.coins || 1, collected: false, ouoUrl: generated.url }); await agent.navigate(generated.url); return { status: 'waiting', variables: { stage: 'ouo_human', ouoUrl: generated.url } }; };
const collectToken = new URL(location.href).searchParams.get('collect');
await log('页面加载触发；阶段：' + (variables.stage || 'start') + '；当前地址：' + location.href);
if (isEnderbit) startPanelTimer(variables.stage === 'cooldown' ? '冷却中' : '运行中');

if (isEnderbit && collectToken) { window.__enderbitPanelStatus = '提交领取'; await panelLog('提交领取'); const result = await apiFetch('/api/earn/collect', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ token: collectToken }) }); if (!result.success) throw new Error(result.message || 'collect failed'); writeCount(readCount() + Number(result.coins || 1)); await panelLog('领取成功'); await markStage('cooldown', { collected: true, collectedAt: Date.now() }); await agent.navigate('/earn'); return { status: 'waiting', variables: { stage: 'cooldown', collected: true } }; }

if (isEnderbit && variables.stage === 'cooldown') { const cooldownMs = readCooldownMs(); if (cooldownMs > 0) return buildFinishResult(!!variables.collected); clearCooldown(); await panelLog('冷却结束，当前页直接进入下一轮'); await markStage('start', { collected: false }); }
if (isEnderbit) return startEnderbitRound();

if (isOuo) { await log('当前已在 Ouo 页面，走页面兜底流程'); const clickElement = (el) => { try { el.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center', inline: 'center' }); } catch (error) {} ['pointerdown', 'mousedown', 'pointerup', 'mouseup', 'click'].forEach((type) => { try { el.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent(type, { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, view: window })); } catch (error) {} }); try { el.click(); } catch (error) {} }; const deadline = Date.now() + 90000; while (Date.now() < deadline) { const embedded = findCallbackInText(document.documentElement.innerHTML); if (embedded && await maybeCollectByUrl(embedded)) { await agent.navigate('https://dash.enderbit.com/earn'); return { status: 'waiting', variables: { stage: 'cooldown', collected: true } }; } const btn = document.querySelector('#btn-main'); const btnText = textOf(btn).toLowerCase(); const countdown = document.querySelector('.countdown'); const countdownText = textOf(countdown).toLowerCase(); const done = !countdown || countdown.classList.contains('end') || countdownText.includes('0 seconds') || countdownText === '0' || countdownText.includes('0 second'); if (btn && done && (btnText.includes('get link') || btnText.includes('continue') || btn.type === 'submit')) { await markStage('enderbit_collect'); clickElement(btn); await log('Ouo 页面兜底：已点击 Get Link'); return { status: 'waiting', variables: { stage: 'enderbit_collect' } }; } const formBtn = document.querySelector('form#form-captcha button#btn-main'); if (formBtn) { await markStage('ouo_get_link'); clickElement(formBtn); await log('Ouo 页面兜底：已点击人机确认'); return { status: 'waiting', variables: { stage: 'ouo_get_link' } }; } await wait(300); } await log('Ouo 页面兜底：等待超时，页面摘要：' + textOf(document.body).slice(0, 180)); return { status: 'waiting', variables: { stage: variables.stage || 'ouo_get_link' } }; };
await log('当前地址不在预期站点内：' + location.href);
return { status: 'waiting', variables };
